svg.title: OpenUSD Composition Contracts 0.1.1 - Root, scene stack and reusable sources
svg.desc: Left to right, the root assembles a vertical scene layer stack with GeoLyr at the bottom. Reusable assets, assemblies and materials retain their own implementation and variant context.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Root composes sibling sublayers

color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Nested assembly interface · DisplayPair
Own GeoLyr + TransLyr + VariLyr
Palette variants coordinate child Finish selections
Scene selects the assembly's public interface

div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center; width: 380px;

span.p:
Published asset interfaces · Cube and Cone
Own GeoLyr + TransLyr + MatLyr + VariLyr
Source identity belongs at the asset/component scope
Asset-owned geometry, intrinsic transforms and materials
Reusable Size / Finish definitions remain in the asset

div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Shared material library · Palette_v001
Reusable material definitions and shader values
Asset MatLyr references the required materials
Library revisions are adopted deliberately

div.style: color: rgb(51, 65, 85) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center; width: 380px;

span.p:
Preserve owner and variant context
Asset / assembly changes belong in that package
Variant-dependent values stay in their owning branch
Scene choices do not duplicate asset implementations

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: SCENE LAYER CLASSES

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

color: rgb(51, 65, 85) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
RUNTIME LAYER · 035_RUNTIME_LYR
RuntimeLyr · deliberate operational snapshots
Live values may remain in session / external storage
Declare writer authority and persistence

div.style: color: rgb(51, 65, 85) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SIM LAYER · 030_SIM_LYR
SimLyr · published solver results
Record scenario, solver, time and provenance

div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
DATA LAYERS · 040_DATA_LYRs
DataLyr · project identity and context
IdentityLyr · scoped occurrence / external IDs
ContextLyr · installation context
Bindings resolve identities to explicit targets
UNSMappingLyr · optional integration mappings

div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center; width: 380px;

span.p:
BASE LAYER · 020_BASE_LYR
MatLyr · scene resources and assignments; respect asset Finish
TransLyr · ordinary placement on occurrence parents
VariLyr · published selections OR Layout scenarios
Relative adjustments stay in their scenario branch
Optional: EnvLyr · LightLyr · CamLyr · RenderLyr
AnimLyr · PhysicsLyr · RigLyr as the profile requires
GeoLyr · hierarchy and asset references · BOTTOM / WEAKEST
Linked packages retain their own implementation

Environment · Render · viewport cameras
Z-up · centimetres · identity World · 60 fps

Declare owner, purpose and removal route
